discovery.note: Three selected tables are titled 阿片ニ關スル營業特許者. The fourth Taiwan-related opium-licensing assignment is the mixed sugar/opium contrast, not another direct business-licence table.

taiwan-tokei-1933:p0353_2.rationale: The annual and locality rows count the same five commercial categories: opium-paste wholesalers, retailers, medicinal-opium wholesalers and smoking-utensil makers and sellers. Narcotic licensing is principal; commercial distribution substantially organises every category and supports trade as the second topic. Drug consumption, treatment and seizures are not measured; the health chapter does not establish health.

korea-1922-23:p0254_1.rationale: All five body columns measure school associations, their supporting population, budgets and average household funding burden. The overlapping annual observations repeat the same financing series across the five records. Education-finance is the specific fitting tag; an undifferentiated burden column is not a separately tabulated tax assessment, rate or receipt. The population is the financing constituency, not a distinct demographic subject. Context mentions rising rates levied, which makes taxation a plausible optional mechanism tag but does not change the principal education-financing subject; the recommended family rule is recorded for central review.

One full part measures sugar and molasses output; the other measures raw-opium stocks, licensed smokers by source population/sex and prepared-opium sales. Both substantial subjects justify its distinct manufacturing/narcotics assignment.

family_findings.recommendation: Use narcotics then trade, with opium-licensing, for all three. The specific licensing tag suffices without redundant opium. The same wholesalers, retailers and suppliers organise the bodies.

Use education then finance, with education-finance, for all five. Prefer the specific funding tag over a broader taxation label inferred from an undifferentiated household burden. No different school-financing measure is established by the Korean/Japanese description conflict.
Retain the distinct manufacturing/narcotics assignment because sugar production and the broader opium stocks/sales/smoker record are both substantial.

rule_clarifications_recommended.recommended_rule: For dedicated school-financing tables, use education-finance for budgets and undifferentiated average household funding burdens. Add taxation when a tax or tax levy is explicitly identified and substantively measured as an assessment, rate, receipt or separate financing source. A burden column or the general phrase rates levied should not automatically create taxation.
rule_clarifications_recommended.reason: Essentially identical columns and overlapping observations were split by worker convention. This recommendation takes the conservative most-specific-label approach.
rule_clarifications_recommended.alternative_for_central_review: If central review establishes that Average Burden per Household specifically measures a compulsory school-association tax, taxation fits its definition and should be added consistently across all five, instead of retained only in the three pilot-c assignments.

rule_clarifications_recommended.recommended_rule: Where every substantive licence category describes wholesalers, retailers and associated commercial suppliers, narcotics/trade is justified. Licensing alone does not require adding government, and a health chapter does not establish a health subject.
rule_clarifications_recommended.reason: The five commercial categories recur in all three direct records.
